root_cause: The connected Netlify MCP deploy action returns a credential-bearing CLI proxy command because source upload must execute from a source directory. The canonical Production Source Snapshot workflow provided exact-SHA packaging but no secure transport handoff.
prevention_rule: Keep deployment in Production Source Snapshot. Supply the temporary Netlify MCP proxy only as an encrypted GitHub Actions secret, verify exact SHA, skip when already live, require release.json exact-SHA plus deploy-id readback, and delete the temporary secret after execution.
evidence: Production Source Snapshot run 35713466502 produced production-source-a324eaa4c1addc8645074313e57731487e31d886 with SHA-256 c0ac8f606a08bc1171546643cb562ead475f870245ec0756f4f9f2002642aeb6.
Netlify production remained commit_ref 368a652f54788f45a9678d0f5045ba1cdb9cb2e1 while main advanced to a324eaa4c1addc8645074313e57731487e31d886.
Netlify MCP deploy command text is not execution evidence.
terminal_rule: LIVE_BEWEZEN requires workflow success and public release.json commit_ref equal to exact dispatched main SHA, production context, non-empty deploy_id, and public target readback.
